The '''Caska system''' was a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TrailingSectors" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creature known as [[Caskan wolf-snake]].<ref name="HonorAmongThieves" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Caska [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
